_comment: Mutation testing for the frontend's pure logic. Nightly, never per-merge:
the command runner re-runs the whole listed suite for every mutant, so the
wall time is minutes even at this scope.
mutate lists only modules with a 1:1 test file and no DOM or backend
dependency. A component or an api/* wrapper would produce mutants that no
test can kill without a browser or a live gateway, which measures the test
harness rather than the tests.
concurrency is capped well below the core count on purpose. Stryker times a
mutant against how long the unmutated suite took, measured once on an idle
machine; running fifteen suites at once then makes healthy mutants time out.
At the default, a third of the mutants on one small module timed out.
coverageAnalysis is off because the command runner cannot report which test
touched which mutant; every mutant costs a full suite run.
thresholds.break is 0 because no full run has finished yet: the scope is
1997 mutants at roughly 2h15m, which is a nightly, not something to pin a
number from locally. The first green nightly reports a score - set break
just under it in that same commit. Until then this job reports but cannot
fail, which is the one gate here that does not yet gate.
After that: raise break when a nightly beats it; never lower it to make a
red run green.
